verdict.rationale: OpenAI maintains a first-party API changelog at developers.openai.com/api/docs/changelog. It records both model launches (new reasoning models, GPT-5.5's capability set) and API or platform changes (API key expiration, key-creation controls, new agent and voice features). A standing deprecations page linked from the changelog tracks dated model shutdowns and their replacements. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how timely and complete the changelog is, and any documented subscription mechanism such as an RSS feed or email alerts for following it.

support.subject: As a developer, model and API changes land in a maintained changelog or release notes I can follow

citations.quote: You can now set expiration dates when creating project API keys.
These reasoning models accept text and image inputs and generate text through the Responses and Chat Completions APIs.
GPT-5.5 supports a 1M token context window, image input, structured outputs, function calling, prompt caching, Batch, tool search, built-in computer use, hosted shell, apply patch, Skills
Upcoming deprecations are listed on the deprecations page
